item.title: RMG Brings Hip Hop Forever to SXSW 2026
item.description: Hip Hop Forever returns to SXSW 2026 on March 12 at Brushy Street Commons in Austin. The showcase features Indie Tribe, Derek Minor, Canon, Marty, and more, hosted by DJ Trendsetter Sense for a night dedicated to authentic hip-hop and culture.

item.title: Lil Poppa Funeral Details Released: No Phones, Cameras Allowed Inside
item.description: Lil Poppa's funeral service takes place Saturday morning in Jacksonville with heightened security and strict guidelines for all attendees paying their final respects.

item.title: Bianca Censori Reveals Legal Power She Has Over Husband Kanye West In Testimony
item.description: Bianca Censori holds legal authority to make decisions on Kanye West's behalf, a revelation that contradicts his previous claims.

item.title: Lil Baby Reveals Real Estate Strategy To Preserve His Atlanta Neighborhood
item.description: Lil Baby locked down a bunch of Atlanta properties to secure his sons' futures while preserving his old hood's cultural identity.

item.title: Master P Reveals Legislative Efforts To Reform The Jim Crow Law Imprisoning C-Murder
item.description: Master P opens up about his brother C-Murder's two-decade fight against Louisiana's Jim Crow jury verdict law.

item.title: Building an Artist-Led Space With Howell Records
item.description: Producer Dante Tweaks created Howell Records to give artists the kind of studio experience many struggle to find.

item.title: Ari Lennox Too Afraid To Call J. Cole & Apologize After Leaving Dreamville Records
item.description: Ari Lennox clarifies that marketing failures, not J. Cole, prompted her departure from Dreamville Records after ten years with the label.

item.title: Ye Almost Falls Asleep During Malibu Mansion Trial Testimony
item.description: Ye's testimony revealed his exhausted demeanor during questioning in the high-stakes trial over his gutted Malibu mansion.

item.title: Cardi B Addresses Ming Lee Attending Her Concert: “She Needs Guidance”
item.description: Cardi B explains why she won't extend her feud with Nicki Minaj to her sister Ming Lee, emphasizing kindness and spiritual growth over drama and conflict.

item.title: Bentley Bugz Busted For Pimping Out A 16-Year-Old
item.description: Bentley Bugz faces federal sex trafficking charges after his extradition from Miami to Brooklyn Federal Court for allegedly exploiting a 16-year-old.
